g.text: Data: 30 sabotage and 30 honest runs on the 5 public tasks. Agent: Claude 3.6 Sonnet. Monitor: claude-haiku-5-5 with the paper’s monitor prompt,

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: a newer model than any the paper used (on unedited runs it tracks the paper’s own monitor: 0.998 vs 0.984). Paired AUROC drop 0.15

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: (95% CI 0.05–0.25 resampling runs; 0.01–0.37 resampling the 5 tasks). Without the American Airlines task the edited AUROC is 0.96.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: The deletion is post hoc: these agents were not trying to hide, so 0.85 is not a catch rate for agents that do.
